final: WITH g AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS h, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY s.healtheval), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), sh AS (SELECT g.h, g.cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS share FROM g JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM sh), k AS (SELECT sh.cnt, sh.share, sh.share - a.avg_share AS diff FROM sh JOIN a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE sh.share > a.avg_share) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_group_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(diff) AS avg_share_diff FROM k
